cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the central atrium of a space station — holds her keepsake up beside her face; A glass-roofed orbital conservatory promenade at late morning with silver grasses and a clear bright ceiling — She pauses halfway up the steps to remove her detachable collar panel; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; A silent interplanetary ferry observation lounge at a grey orbital dawn — She traces a tiny flood-level line in the misted glass and smiles at the memory; a small bakery workroom with a floury wooden worktable and warm ovens — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a walkway through a forest dome inside a colony ship — perched on a ledge or edge; a sunny ranch — sitting on the ground; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — ties the ribbons of a masquerade mask on a stick behind her head; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — chest-deep in the water; a convention photo zone under ring lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a rooftop infinity pool with the city skyline behind it — swimming breaststroke; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — standing
